upload.title: Split a bill
upload.subtitle: Snap a photo of your receipt. No account needed.
upload.guestDisabledDescription: The admin of this server has turned off receipt uploads for guests. Sign in to split a bill.

people.title: Who's splitting?
people.subtitle: Add the names of everyone sharing this bill.
people.rescanDescription: Describe what needs to be corrected and AI will re-scan the receipt.
people.rescanPlaceholder: e.g., "The total should be $45.99" or "There are 3 tacos, not 1"
people.creatorAlwaysIncluded: You are the creator and always participate
people.guestCountHint: Your own place is included. Guest names can be entered later.

assign.title: Assign items
assign.shareForClaiming: Share Link — Let Everyone Claim Their Items
assign.shareHint: Don't know who had what? Share the link and let each person pick their own items.
assign.validationPricePositive: Price must be greater than zero.
assign.validationQtyPositive: Quantity must be a positive whole number.

claim.sessionInvalid: This session link is invalid or has been removed.
claim.sessionFinalizedDescription: This claiming session has been finalized. View the summary below.
claim.personalLinkHint: Your personal link lets another device continue as you. Only open it on your own devices: anyone with it can act as you in this split.
claim.personalLinkShareTitle: My private BillOK link (don't share it)
claim.personalLinkCopied: Personal link copied. Open it on your other device to continue as yourself. Anyone with this link can act as you in this split.
claim.personalLinkInvalid: This personal link no longer works. That person may have been removed from the split.
claim.personalLinkShared: Only send this link to yourself: anyone with it can act as you in this split.
claim.personalLinkOfferBody: Continuing lets this device claim and act as {name}. Only continue if you are {name}.
claim.personalLinkOfferReplaces: This device joined this split as {current}. Continuing switches it to {name}, and only {current}'s personal link can switch it back.
claim.removePersonDescription: Their claims are removed too, and items only they claimed go back to unclaimed.
claim.removedFromSession: Someone removed you from this split. Join again to keep going.
claim.finalizeDescription: Everyone's totals are worked out and the split is locked, so nobody can change their claims after this.
claim.groupSizeHint: Enter 2+ if joining as a couple or group
claim.personalTipDescription: Choose how much you personally want to tip. You may leave 0. You cannot change others’ tips.
claim.personalTipInvalid: Enter an amount of at least 0 with no more than two decimal places.
claim.personalTipPendingTotals: Preliminary participant totals show dishes only. Your voluntary tip is added to your own total when the split is finalized.
claim.tipForWaiter: Total voluntary tips for the waiter
claim.payerReimbursementsTitle: Reimbursements to the payer for this receipt
claim.payerReimbursementsNote: Initial amounts before transfers and confirmations. No transfer to yourself is needed.
claim.personalReimbursementNote: This includes your dishes and personal tips. SBP transfer and receipt confirmation are not available yet.
claim.payerSbpPrivacy: For this bill. Only you can change your details. Other participants cannot see them yet.
claim.payerSbpLoadError: Could not load details. Refresh the page.
claim.payerSbpUnverified: The number is not SMS verified. Listing in the bank directory does not guarantee phone transfers.
claim.payerSbpRecipientUnavailable: Could not load payer details. Refresh the page.
claim.payerSbpRecipientNotConfigured: The payer has not provided an SBP destination yet.
claim.payerSbpRecipientUnknownBank: Bank no longer in directory — ask the payer
claim.payerSbpRecipientDisclaimer: Transfer using your bank app. Showing contact information does not confirm payment or receipt.
claim.paymentAwaitingVerification: You marked the payment. The payer has not verified receipt of funds.
claim.paymentDeclarationDisclaimer: Press only after making the transfer. This button neither sends nor verifies funds.
claim.paymentDeclarationFailed: Could not record your payment declaration
claim.paymentDeclarationLoadFailed: Could not check payment status. Refresh the page.
claim.payerPaymentReviewHint: A payment declaration does not verify receipt. Confirm only after checking your bank.
claim.payerPaymentDeclarationNotice: New payment declaration: {name}. Check incoming funds.
claim.payerPaymentDeclarationBatchNotice: New payment declarations: {count}. Check incoming funds.
claim.paymentVerifiedNotice: The payer confirmed receipt of your transfer.
claim.partsUnknownOriginal: Original total unknown; remaining portions are not estimated.
claim.partsPreliminary: Provisional totals. Participants can still change their portions; before finalizing the organizer will confirm that all portions have been reported.
claim.presenceConnectionLost: Connection lost. Your receipt participation is saved; your status will update after reconnecting.
claim.finalizationOrganizerHint: Only the creator may appoint a registered account by email. After signing in and joining this receipt, this organizer can approve the portions and finalize the split. The payer and anonymous guests have no such permission.
claim.finalizationOrganizerActive: An additional organizer is appointed. You can replace or revoke their permission.
claim.finalizationOrganizerNoClaimHint: You are authorized to finalize this bill. You do not have to claim any dishes if you did not eat.
claim.finalizationOrganizerSaved: Organizer permission updated. Please approve the split again.
claim.partsAwaitingConfirmation: Provisional: waiting for the receipt creator to confirm everyone’s portions.
claim.knownPartsHint: Use only if the original number is known. This is not the number of purchased items or an extra payment.
claim.knownPartsOverLimit: Claims exceed the known original count. Correct the claims or original count.
claim.knownPartsNotFullyClaimed: Known portions remain unassigned. The creator must assign the remainder or correct the count.
claim.nameChangedNotice: Your name in this receipt was changed to: {name}
claim.noGuestPlacesLeft: All guest places are taken. Contact the receipt creator.
claim.guestPlaceConflict: Someone else took this place. Choose another available place.
claim.recoverRegisteredPlace: Recover my place through my account

result.expiredMessage: This split has expired. Splits are available for 7 days.
result.invalidMessage: This split link is invalid or has been removed.
result.expiredCreatorHistory: The guest link expired. This finalized bill is still available in your signed-in account history.
result.tipForWaiter: Total voluntary tips for the waiter
